purpose: Schema-normalized wrapper for the universal pre-formal candidate robustness gate. No new scientific content or performance analysis.

candidates.name: Labor-representation certification shock
candidates.hypothesis: A newly public NLRB election outcome or certification changes the observable labor-representation state of an employer. The economic channel is potential labor-cost, bargaining-power and operational-governance change; no return sign is assumed ex ante.
candidates.construction: Use the fixed NLRB election/result event taxonomy and public-observation boundary defined in the candidate contract; preserve case identifiers, certification/tally metadata and a frozen employer-to-issuer mapping. No outcome-conditioned asset, parameter, threshold, horizon or variant selection is permitted.
sources: DiNardo et al., Long-Run Impacts of Unions on Firms: New Evidence from Financial Markets (NBER Working Paper 14709; QJE 2012)
candidates.next_gate: historical NLRB archive completeness + public-clock semantics + frozen employer-to-issuer mapping + case-status lineage + independent PIT reproduction
